claim_ceiling: TF-IDF constrained hierarchical Leiden at 174k is ACCEPTED and production-ready for serving. Dense embeddings (citation-role, debiased, section-specific) at 174k remain BLOCKED on legal-distance computation (3/26 years ACCEPTED). No product-readiness claim for full multi-view fractal map while lane blocked.
evidence_summary: Verified 12 primary evidence files across 6 experimental categories: (1) Flat v26 at 174k: 0/4 TF-IDF modes PASS — severe fragmentation (>99% singletons), no monotonicity, nesting 0.44-0.90. (2) Constrained hierarchical 174k: 4/4 TF-IDF modes achieve nesting=1.0, zero fragmentation, branch_delta +0.03 to +0.09, area_delta +0.03 to +0.13, improvement_rate 57-90%. (3) Dense 99k coarse sweep: PASS at coarse_res=0.15-0.2 (improvement_rate 55-59%, zero fragmentation), FAIL at 0.25-0.3. (4) Citation-role 1k: citing/following PASS v26 with constrained hierarchical (improvement_rate=100%, branch_delta +0.06 to +0.09), criticizing FAIL (sparse). (5) Debiased_citation_blended 1k: PASS at coarse_res=0.15-0.3 (improvement_rate 66-75%, zero fragmentation). (6) Dense 3yr 2000-2002: PASS structural (nesting=1.0, branch_delta up to +0.14, area_delta up to +0.30, zoom branch rate 71%), FAIL v26 flat, fragmentation 14-41%. Scale dependency confirmed: larger corpus → better refinement, lower fragmentation. TF-IDF product integration complete (4 modes, full artifacts). Factory direction v30 discrepancy correctly caught and reverted. No leakage, gaming, or unsupported claims detected.
